import bpy,math,json
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector,Matrix
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'];assert not craft.get('stone15_plants')
bank=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'];deps=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get();bvh=BVHTree.FromObject(bank,deps)
sources=[bpy.data.objects['Combined_front_A creeping salt plant leaf.%03d'%i] for i in range(105,112)]
anchor=Vector((-4.247,1.3,1.189))
def linear(v):return v/12.92 if v<=.04045 else ((v+.055)/1.055)**2.4
mats=[]
for name,color in [('S15_SaltLeaf_mids',(.40,.46,.25)),('S15_SaltLeaf_shade',(.31,.39,.215))]:
 m=bpy.data.materials.new(name);m.use_nodes=True;p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
 p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=tuple(linear(x) for x in color)+(1,);p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.86
 m.diffuse_color=tuple(linear(x) for x in color)+(1,);mats.append(m)
# Two interrupted beds occupy the unused shoulder; the stairs and walking inlet stay clear.
locations=[(5.06,-3.18,2.15,.1),(5.72,-3.36,2.35,1.7),(6.28,-2.91,1.8,3.1),(5.47,-2.68,1.65,4.2),(4.85,4.4,1.9,1.2),(5.39,4.76,2.15,2.8),(5.8,4.35,1.5,4.8)]
records=[]
for j,(x,y,scale,angle) in enumerate(locations):
 hit,normal,index,distance=bvh.ray_cast(Vector((x,y,6)),Vector((0,0,-1)),10);assert hit is not None,(x,y)
 # Copy the project leaf form and UV; size, angle and root height follow the authored bank.
 mat=Matrix.Translation(Vector((x,y,hit.z+.012)))@Matrix.Rotation(angle,4,'Z')@Matrix.Diagonal(Vector((scale,scale,scale*.85,1)))@Matrix.Translation(-anchor)
 for k,source in enumerate(sources):
  o=source.copy();o.data=source.data.copy();o.name='S15 salt shoulder bed %d leaf %d'%(j,k);craft.objects.link(o)
  o.matrix_world=mat@source.matrix_world;o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(mats[(j+k)%3==0]);o['stone15_plant']=True
 records.append({'xy':[x,y],'root_height':hit.z+.012,'scale':scale})
craft['stone15_plants']=True;bpy.context.view_layer.update();bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;(root/'captures/shipyard_stone_20261115/plant_placement.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('S15_SHOULDER_PLANTS',len(locations),len(locations)*len(sources),records)
